name.description: The agent's name; the same as its folder under deployments/<team>/. The team base's subagent template names are taken

team.description: The team that owns the agent, one of platform/teams.txt; the agent runs in team-<team>

owner.description: Who to ask about this agent (a GitHub handle or an email)

runtime.description: stock: kagent's built-in runtime. coding: the platform's coding agent (file tools, bash with approvals, subagents, /implement). byo: the team's own image (set image)

image.description: byo only: the team's image, <allowed registry>/<path>@sha256:<64 hex>. A tag is refused, so the image cannot change under a running agent. The allowed registry on kind is the local one, on a private address at port 5000 (make byo-push prints the reference)

command.description: byo only: the image's command (kagent refuses a byo Harness without one), e.g. ["node", "/app/src/main.ts"]

tokenCap.description: The agent's monthly token cap, inside its team's cap

subagents.description: Subagents by name, from the team base's templates

tools.description: Catalog tools by name. A write tool (github-write, demo-delete-branch) always pauses for a human's approval; a read tool may ask for it with requireApproval: true

github.description: GitHub settings for the agent's catalog tools

repos.description: The repos the agent's github-write tools may change, as owner/name. A write call on any other repo is refused at agentgateway; with no list, every write call is refused

skills.description: Skills by name, from platform/skills/; make deploy pins each skill's image

platform.description: Set by the platform (the ApplicationSet), not by a values file: the pinned skill images
